Hi all, 
I am running a mediation model (2 IVs, 6 Mediators, 1 DV,  1 control variable)

However, as I estimate the SEM model, I found that, all the loadings of the latent variable's indicators remain the same as in CFA, except one latent variable, all its loadings get smaller compared with CFA (from .600; .726; .658  to .399; .404; .235). 

Why would this happen? 

Thanks in advance for your time.
